caption: The video captures a male performer standing on a stage bathed in deep blue light on a patterned rug before a microphone on a stand. He holds an electric guitar with a yellow headstock wearing a black t-shirt and dark jeans. A bright white glow burns at the left while a grid of small lights dots the dark background. His right hand moves repeatedly over the strings near the guitar body in continuous strumming as his left hand adjusts along the fretboard. His head tilts downward toward the instrument while the back of another person's head enters the left foreground, growing prominent as the viewpoint drifts. His head then lifts back toward the microphone, and in the later frames his mouth opens near the mic as though singing.
